# Context-Saver (llms.txt)

> One MCP connection. Every tool. ~90% less context.

Context-Saver is a Model Context Protocol gateway (aggregator/multiplexer).
You connect ONE MCP server to your client; it fronts any number of downstream
MCP servers and lazy-loads their tool schemas only when a turn needs them.

## How an agent should use it

1. `cs_discover` — search the aggregated catalog (cheap, no schemas).
2. `cs_plan` — pass the user's task; get the minimal recommended toolset.
3. `cs_load` — load exactly those tools; they then appear as normal MCP tools
   (the client receives `notifications/tools/list_changed`). Their schemas are
   also echoed in the `cs_load` result.
4. Call loaded tools directly, or use `cs_call` (auto-loads, no schema needed).
5. `cs_unload` when done; `cs_status` for accounting.

Never guess downstream tool names — always discover or plan first.

## Meta-tools (fixed cost, ~680 tokens)

| Tool | Input | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| cs_discover | `{query?, refresh?}` | list/filter catalog |
| cs_plan | `{task}` | score task → toolset |
| cs_load | `{tools: string[]}` | load schemas (globs OK: `github:*`) |
| cs_unload | `{tools?: string[]}` | unload (all if omitted) |
| cs_status | `{verbose?}` | servers, sessions, token savings |
| cs_call | `{tool, args?}` | direct call with auto-load |

## CLI

```
node context-saver.mjs                       # stdio gateway (default)
  --config <file>        config path (default ~/.context-saver/config.json)
  --transport http       Streamable HTTP server (also serves legacy /sse)
  --port N --host H      bind address (default 127.0.0.1:3270)
  --auth / --no-auth     OAuth 2.1 gate for HTTP mode (default: on)
  --approval-token <t>   pairing code the consent page demands off-loopback (required there)
  --demo                 3 built-in demo downstream servers, zero setup
  --client               interactive REPL client (great with --demo)
  --doctor               self-diagnostic, exit 0 = healthy
  --version / --help
```

## Config (accepts Claude-style `mcpServers` or `servers`)

```json
{
  "servers": {
    "filesystem": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "/path"] },
    "github":     { "url": "https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/", "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}" } }
  }
}
```

Zero dependencies. Node ≥ 18.17. MIT license.
